description: A ground-level photograph depicts an agricultural field featuring rows of young, leafy green trees extending into the mid-ground. In the foreground, a dirt track, possibly an access road, cuts across the scene, with patches of green grass growing through it. The trees are planted in straight, evenly spaced lines. The ground between the tree rows is covered with short green vegetation and some bare soil. In the background, a denser line of mature trees forms a boundary under a light grey, overcast sky. The image likely illustrates a type of permanent crop or fruit tree plantation, consistent with CORINE Land Cover (CLC) or CLC+ categories for permanent crops.
